text: According to the Gibbs free energy criterion (delta-G = delta-H - T*delta-S), which condition indicates that a reaction proceeds spontaneously (is exergonic) at constant temperature and pressure?
choices: A negative delta-H regardless of the sign of delta-S or the temperature
explanation: A negative delta-G (exergonic) indicates a spontaneous reaction under the Gibbs free energy criterion. delta-G > 0 (endergonic) indicates a non-spontaneous reaction, delta-G = 0 corresponds to equilibrium rather than net spontaneous change, and enthalpy alone does not determine spontaneity because the -T*delta-S term can flip the overall sign, especially at high temperature.
